```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

senate <- read_csv(
  "data/north-carolina/processed/us_senate_2026_statewide.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
leader <- senate |> arrange(desc(votes)) |> slice(1)
```
